name: pley
description: Pley media server monorepo (Rust apps are built with cargo, see Cargo.toml)

scripts.check: bun run --cwd packages/picture-subtitles check && bun run --cwd apps/web check && bun run --cwd apps/desktop check
scripts.tv:check: bun run --cwd packages/picture-subtitles check && bun run --cwd packages/tv check && bun run --cwd apps/tizen check
